description: The Hessen network provided by E. Codina Sancho of the Universitat Politecnica de Catalunya, whose asymmetric link cost functions are described in the repository's AsymmetricCostFunctions_Codina.pdf; the links here carry the symmetric BPR columns only. From Transportation Networks for Research, the traffic assignment test networks that continue H. Bar-Gera's TNTP collection: a directed road network with link capacities and free-flow times and an origin-destination trip table, in the files Hessen-Asym_net.tntp and Hessen-Asym_trips.tntp of the repository at commit d1639b4ef218.

name: TNTP Hessen asymmetric traffic assignment network

recipe.reason: Its network file's column header names nine columns (init_node to toll) but every link line holds ten values, so which column each value belongs to is not stated and the tntp parser refuses the file. It becomes fetchable when the source's header names every column.
